title: The lockstep rule's wording does not say whether it binds at the exact version or the minor
description: opum-agent asked (2026-09-15 17:26Z) whether lore 0.7.1 exists and whether the quest 0.7.1 / lore 0.7.0 gap is drift. Measured: it is not. The convention is normative in this repo CHANGELOG (0.5.0: the two "move together at every stacked release: one version number naming the pair") and has two declared one-time exceptions, 0.6.2 and 0.7.1, each announced in its own entry. The CLAUDE.md profile sentence "Both CLIs ship paired at the same version" carries neither the exactness nor the exception, so quoted alone it reads as a violation. Fix the profile wording; the exception belongs in the same sentence as the claim.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md profile states in one sentence that the lockstep binds at the exact version AND that a declared unilateral patch is its documented exception
Both instances (0.6.2, 0.7.1) are named with what made each one legitimate, sourced to the CHANGELOG entry that declared it
The profile records that a quest version declaration in a managed CLAUDE.md block implies nothing about a lore release at that number
lore check exits 0 on the branch and every required check on the PR into dev is green on that PR head SHA

implementationNotes: Measured rather than taken from the relay. npm latest: quest 0.7.1 (published 2026-09-15T16:03:38Z), lore 0.7.0 (12:28:49Z). Full version lists show the pair has diverged at patch level once before: quest has no 0.6.1 on npm, lore does. Tags here: v0.6.0 v0.6.1 v0.6.2 v0.7.0 v0.7.1 -- v0.6.1 tagged, never published. The binding is EXACT-version: CHANGELOG 0.5.0 established one version number naming the pair, and both breaks (0.6.2, 0.7.1) were declared in their own entries at the time, so the repo record is not ambiguous even though the CLAUDE.md profile sentence was. 0.7.1 needed no lore counterpart: QCLI-302 (task start off the retired Blocked literal, doctor task_status_off_flow) and QCLI-299 (publish visibility gate) are both quest-internal; lore-cli consumed the fix for LCLI-333, it did not co-author it. dev is 3 commits past v0.7.1 and touches no src/ or package.json -- two tracker-only, one also touching .github/workflows and CLAUDE.md -- so nothing shippable is pending here.
